statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9)
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is clinically necessary
The service is needed to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The service is needed to assess for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion
